articles.title: The 65" Samsung S90F 4K QD-OLED TV Is Better Than Its 2026 Successor, and It's on Sale for Labor Day
articles.summary: The best gaming TV just dropped in price during eBay's annual Labor Day Sale. For a limited time, Electronic Express is offering the 65" Samsung S90F 4K OLED Smart TV for just $1,038.39 with free shipping when you apply 20% off coupon code " LABORDAY20 ".
body: The S90F is the 2025 model in Samsung's S90 OLED TV lineup. This is the last TV in the S90 series that's equipped with a quantum dot OLED panel. This year, Samsung decided to remove quantum dot technology from the S90 series, which means the only way to get a QD-OLED TV in 2026 is splurging for the S95H TV. The 65" S95H TV sells for $2,800.

The S90F is equipped with Samsung's coveted quantum dot OLED panel which delivers a brighter picture and richer colors than W-OLED panels (like the one found in the S90H) while retaining all of the other benefits of OLED: near instaneous response time, true black levels, near infinite contrast ratio, and outstanding viewing angles. The Samsung S90F also has the features you'd want in a gaming TV, including a native 120Hz panel and HDMI 2.1 ports so you can run PlayStation 5 or Xbox Series X games in 4K resolution at up to 120fps.

articles.title: Sony To Pay Out Nearly $8 Million In Class-Action Settlement Over Game Prices
articles.summary: Sony is set to pay out nearly $8 million to PlayStation customers as part of a settlement regarding digital game prices. The settlement ( via IGN ) comes after Sony's motion to dismiss the lawsuit was denied, and settlement class members across a more-than-four-year period are potentially eligible…
body: The lawsuit, originally filed back in 2024, alleged that Sony established a monopoly over PlayStation Store prices by making publishers "cede control over the final price to Sony" and that Sony "eliminated the last vestiges of price competition when it stopped allowing outside retailers to sell digital download codes that could be redeemed on the PlayStation Store."

Sony is not agreeing to wrongdoing as part of the settlement, and will be avoiding a civil trial if the terms are agreed upon by the court. Once that happens, the claims against Sony will be dismissed "with prejudice," meaning another lawsuit on the subject cannot be filed.

You are potentially eligible for a payout if you purchased one of the affected games via the PlayStation Store between April 1, 2019 and December 31, 2023. Dozens of games are listed in the official court documents, including Nier: Automata, Resident Evil 4, The Last of Us Remastered, and Vita games like Uncharted: Golden Abyss and Killzone: Mercenary.
points: Sony is set to pay out nearly $8 million to PlayStation customers as part of a settlement regarding digital game prices.

articles.title: Star Wars Zero Company Was Originally Pitched as a Titanfall Universe Game
articles.summary: As part of a larger report on Star Wars Zero Company, Game File's Stephen Totilo uncovered a lot of interesting details about the game's development. The big headline was that the bulk of the studio was furloughed just weeks before launch as Bit Reactor ran out of money, but there's hope that those…
body: Star Wars Zero Company was originally pitched as a game in the Titanfall universe.

Game File dug up legal documents pertaining to a lawsuit between Bit Reactor leadership which paints a picture of Zero Company's development. Director Greg Foertsch worked with studio co-founder Alison Kelly to develop pitches for a tactics game, which eventually landed a meeting with Respawn Entertainment co-founder Vince Zampella. The late gaming executive asked Foertsch to make a pitch based on Respawn's own IP, which would've meant the game would be connected to the Titanfall universe.

Game File notes the pitch was directly linked to Apex Legends, which is set in the Titanfall universe, but it's unclear if the signature mechs would've returned or if it would've been rooted in the hero characters from Apex Legends, similar to the upcoming Rainbow Six Tactics game. Zampella ultimately rejected the pitch for the Titanfall universe tactics game and instead told the team to try again, this time with the Star Wars IP, which Respawn has a heavy hand in.
points: As part of a larger report on Star Wars Zero Company, Game File's Stephen Totilo uncovered a lot of interesting details about the game's development.

articles.title: Stanley Kubrick’s Daughter Responds to Eyes Wide Shut Conspiracy Theories
articles.summary: Stanley Kubrick’s daughter Vivian has addressed rumors surrounding Eyes Wide Shut, debunking claims that key scenes were removed after the director's death.
body: Vivian Kubrick, the daughter of the late director Stanley Kubrick, has addressed conspiracy theories about her father’s final film, Eyes Wide Shut, conspiracies spread, in part, a few years ago by podcaster Joe Rogan and his guest, filmmaker Roger Avary.

“You know, this is as good a time as any to finally address the missing 20 minutes from Eyes Wide Shut. It’s a story that has been circulating for many years, so let me tell you what I actually know and don’t know. For context, my father always had his outtakes incinerated once a film was finished, specifically to prevent the studio from later re-editing his work or creating alternative versions. There has been a lot of speculation that some 20 minutes were removed from Eyes Wide Shut after he died,” Kubrick posted on X.
points: Stanley Kubrick’s daughter Vivian has addressed rumors surrounding Eyes Wide Shut, debunking claims that key scenes were removed after the director's death.

articles.title: CD Projekt Red Boss 'Isn't Worried' About Delays for Next-Gen Consoles as RAM Prices Soar
articles.summary: CD Projekt Red joint CEO Michał Nowakowski opened up about the developer’s reaction to the rising price of consoles and the possibility of next-generation hardware getting delayed due to RAMaggedon.
body: Speaking with The Game Business in a September 1 interview, Nowakowski said he’s “not worried” about console costs potentially affecting sales of CDPR’s titles.

“Consoles are still necessary to broaden the audience on the casual or semi-casual level. It’s important to have [something] easy to plug in and enjoy gaming,” he told the outlet. “I'm a big believer that they’re going to weather the storm. Pricing is the objective challenge. And the rumors... we hear them about the next gen being delayed. I don’t know if they’re true.”
He’s not very fussed about this possibility, either. For him, how CDPR reaches gamers is “a little irrelevant” — it’s the content that matters most, regardless of how it gets in players’ hands.

“Content is the king. And if the content is right, people will find a way to play it,” Nowakowski explained. “When we launch, if PS5, Xbox Series X/S is what people are playing, we’re going to be there. We’re going to find a business model that’s going to work for us, that’s going to be fine for players, and that’s it.

articles.title: Releasing Cyberpunk 2077 In Its Poor State “Was For Sure Wrong,” CD Projekt Admits
articles.summary: CD Projekt Red's RPG Cyberpunk 2077 infamously launched in December 2020 in such a poor technical state that Sony took the rare move to remove it from the PlayStation Store. Thousands of people refunded the game.
body: Speaking to The Game Business, Nowakowski said COVID "was a factor" in the game's rough state at launch, because "the team was getting exhausted in a different way." He admitted there were "people outside telling us we should launch," and fans lobbied for this as well. The developers themselves also "wanted to push it out the door" because the ongoing development was "really tiring."
Looking back on it, now with the benefit of hindsight, Nowakowski said, "The decision to launch was for sure wrong, period. There is no denying it."
That being said, Nowakowski said, "There were no magical investors telling us, 'You have to get this out.'" Instead, he said, "It was much more complicated and psychological."

CD Projekt's fiscal years follow the calendar and end on December 31. Cyberpunk 2077 was released on December 10 in 2020, and this timing led people to wonder if the developer put the game out then instead of delaying to 2021 to meet the fiscal deadline. There is, after all, precedent for game developers pushing games out the door in a rough state to hit certain fiscal deadlines.

articles.title: GTA 6 Soars to No. 1 on Netflix's Movie Chart
articles.summary: After 13 years of waiting, Grand Theft Auto 6 is finally starting to feel real — and fans have been desperate for every scrap of information they can get. Recent leaks offered glimpses of the game ahead of its official reveal, while Rockstar's latest footage confirmed that GTA 6 is shaping up to be…
body: So when Rockstar brought its latest GTA 6 footage to Netflix, it knew people would watch. The company probably didn't expect over 31.1 million people to do so in just a few days.

Grand Theft Auto VI: An Extended Look, the nearly 27-minute gameplay showcase that premiered on Netflix last week, hit No. 1 on the English film list in 87 of the 93 countries tracked globally, according to Netflix. That's a pretty remarkable result for what is, essentially, a very long video game trailer. The showcase has also been uploaded to YouTube, where it's now passed 17 million views.
The Netflix showcase finally gave everyone a lengthy look at the game following two shorter trailers — and there was plenty to unpack.

For starters, Vice City is only part of the story. Rockstar says the playable area in GTA 6 will be roughly three times the size of Red Dead Redemption 2 's playable map. The showcase gave us a better sense of that scale, jumping between the city, beaches, rural areas, and a Florida-inspired wilderness packed with wildlife.

articles.title: Star Wars Zero Company Is the Andor Replacement No One Expected
articles.summary: I’ve never been what you would call a “Star Wars guy.” As much as I enjoy George Lucas’ original film trilogy, they always struck me as perfectly fun popcorn movies rather than masterpieces of American cinema.
body: So consider me as surprised as anyone that Star Wars: Zero Company is currently one of my favorite games of 2026. Bit Reactor’s debut game successfully adapts the Star Wars universe to a tense tactics game built from XCOM’s bones. Beyond its strong strategy systems, Zero Company is winning me over by telling the kind of Star Wars story I’m actually interested in hearing: an economic space opera.

Set during the Clone Wars era, Zero Company follows a mercenary squad, led by Hawks, a hardass, sarcastic leader who will take any gig if the money is right. They are hired to stop a Separatist cult that has begun spreading a mysterious plague around. That main story isn’t exactly groundbreaking, doling out the same kind of supervillain dynamics that have kept me at arm’s length from Star Wars historically.

articles.title: Rockstar Games unveils its official GTA Online RP server, mere months before GTA 6
articles.summary: Rockstar Games hasn't said much of anything about GTA 6 's potential multiplayer offerings, but the developer is making strides for GTA Online 's roleplaying community. A watch-only nopixel 5 closed beta is coming next week.
body: More than three years ago, Rockstar bought out the modding team and the tech powering FiveM, a GTA Online RP platform the studio had once tried to bury. Today, the studio revealed the fruits of that partnership: Rockstar's official roleplaying server, nopixel 5.

"Rockstar is finally throwing its weight behind nopixel, a group that has long redefined roleplay via deep immersion and custom map tweaks," Rockstar wrote in its announcement blog. "Starting 8 September, nopixel 5 closed beta kicks off, allowing a handful of invited players to jump in using the studio's own launcher."

Sadly, it sounds like the nopixel 5 closed beta will only be available to select content creators and well-known GTA Online roleplayers, though you can watch along via livestreams next week. Rockstar's promising "familiar faces reprising fan-favorite characters and new personalities beginning their own stories."

articles.title: Final Fantasy Meets Zelda in Steam's Best New RPG
articles.summary: Years before the iPhone debuted in 2007, Square Enix began developing Final Fantasy and Dragon Quest games for Japanese mobile phone networks. Games like Before Crisis: Final Fantasy VII were built for Japan's then-advanced flip phones, with gameplay mechanics reliant on hardware like a camera…
body: It took only a few years for touchscreen smartphones to eclipse the popularity and viability of flip phones for video games. RPG franchises like Final Fantasy, Dragon Quest, and Fire Emblem all have wildly popular mobile entries. But one RPG franchise, developed natively for mobile phones, is often overlooked. Over 15 years ago, Zenonia proved that mobile phones could run complete, console-worthy games — without ties to an outside IP.

Developed and published by Gamevil, Zenonia first launched in 2008 for mobile phones in South Korea. It reached the United States’ App Store in 2009 and the Google Play Store in 2010, before getting Nintendo DSi and PlayStation Portable ports. A few years after dropping off several mobile game stores, such as the iPhone App Store, gamers can once again experience Zenonia’s classic RPG gameplay on PC.

articles.title: New Avengers: Secret Wars Casting Announcement Sparks Wild Fan Theories
articles.summary: With just a few months to go until Avengers: Doomsday hits movie theaters, casting rumors are ramping up for next year's sequel, Avengers: Secret Wars. Marvel Studios has said very little officially about 2027's Avengers movie, particularly when it comes to casting.
body: Thanks to a new report from Deadline, we finally have some unofficial casting news for Avengers: Secret Wars.

British actor Noah Jupe has reportedly joined the cast of Avengers: Secret Wars, according to Deadline. Jupe's role in the sixth Avengers movie was not revealed, but his character is "expected to play a key part in the story," Deadline said. Jupe is best known for his roles in the A Quiet Place films, where he plays Marcus Abbott, the son of Emily Blunt and John Krasinski's characters. Jupe also appeared in Eternals director Chloé Zhao's Oscar-winning Hamnet (as Hamlet) and in The Night Manager with Tom Hiddleston. Jupe recently co-starred alongside Spider-Man: Brand New Day 's Sadie Sink in the West End production of Romeo & Juliet.

In the absence of official confirmation, fans have speculated on a number of possible roles for Noah Jupe in the MCU. Top of the list seems to be Franklin Richards, son of Reed Richards and Sue Storm, who is a newborn in The Fantastic Four: First Steps. Given that some MCU youngsters — namely T'Challa II from Black Panther: Wakanda Forever — are apparently aging up in the MCU, perhaps Franklin Richards will too.
points: With just a few months to go until Avengers: Doomsday hits movie theaters, casting rumors are ramping up for next year's sequel, Avengers: Secret Wars.

articles.title: Former id Software producer says the team faced the 'worst crunch' in the series' history on Doom: The Dark Ages – Revelations: 'There were days where I didn't see my son'
articles.summary: The situation surrounding Doom: The Dark Ages – Revelations was already grim. Id Software put out a fantastic expansion that addressed many issues present in the ( still pretty good ) base game, placing it among the best works the FPS specialists have ever produced.
body: Now, it also appears that getting Revelations to the finish line was a punishing experience for those involved, at least according to former id Software producer Andrew Willis. Speaking on the Kiwi Talkz podcast for Insider Gaming, Willis revealed that the team experienced a gnarly level of crunch in the months leading up to Revelations' release.

"It was tight," Willis explained. "There were two months where I was working something like at least 12 hours every day. I know I hit 17 a couple of days." Willis goes on to describe the experience as "brutal" and says that most of the expansion was put together "in three or four months."

That's a ridiculously short turnaround for an expansion that's around six hours long, especially when you consider the main game—which runs at about 20 hours—took five years to build. Revelations' development timeframe was meant to be even shorter. But Willis says the expansion encountered feature-creep, with new elements being added as the DLC was built.
points: The situation surrounding Doom: The Dark Ages – Revelations was already grim.

articles.title: Double Fine will finally make Brutal Legend 2, but only if its new Kickstarter campaign reaches an almost impossible $100m
articles.summary: Almost two decades on from its first heavy-metal-infused open-world game, Double Fine pinky promises it'll finally make Brutal Legend 2… if the developer's new Kickstarter campaign somehow manages to scrape together $100m (about £74m).
body: Double Fine slid out from under Xbox's ownership earlier this summer, after the console maker kickstarted another round of layoffs affecting 3,200 jobs over the course of the next year. Four Xbox first-party studios also changed ownership, with Double Fine managing to regain both its independence and its entire gameography ( Psychonauts, Kiln, and Brutal Legend included).

Now, the famed developer has returned to Kickstarter to raise money for ' Amnesia Fortnight 2026, Indie Reboot ' - a two-week game jam that'll eventually result in a retail-ready game, plus a behind-the-scenes documentary from the 2 Player Productions crew (of PsychOdyssey fame).

Double Fine's Brutal Legend 2 stretch goal is likely the studio holding onto its signature cheeky humor because, not to burst anyone's bubble, raising $100m on Kickstarter is almost impossible. The most successful Kickstarter campaign of all time raised $46m for a 3D printer. In the video gaming world, Shenmue 3 reigns supreme with a $6m haul.

body: Become a Nephilim and fight to reclaim the fallen city of Gildenarch in Crimson Moon, a gothic high renaissance action RPG where every hunt lets you discover powerful loot, forge unique builds, and take on fearsome bosses - solo or in 2-player online co-op.
